limitations: Exponential intensity distribution; stationary one-dimensional Brownian position only.
No uniform joint large-distance/slow-refresh approximation or first-passage theorem.
The original source formula implicitly determines stationary observables; it may be regarded as strong implicit coverage of some consequences.
The source supplemental derivation and all wider spectral literature have not been exhaustively inspected.
scientific_integrity: Exact stationary Fourier transform and physical model are credited to Arutkin and Reuveni; the present conclusions are asymptotic spectral analyses of that transform. No independent validation is claimed.
title: Exact spectral tail and exponentially weak pole in Brownian diffusion with refreshed reset rates
